summary: Master the art of communication in hospitality management. Join our training course to improve guest relations and team collaboration for exceptional service.
lede: Effective Communication in Hospitality Management helps hospitality professionals communicate with intention across guest, colleague, and management interactions. You will learn to listen actively, ask better questions, manage tone and body language, and frame messages clearly to build trust and deliver consistent, personal service. The course also develops practical skills for handling complaints, de-escalating tense situations, communicating sensitively across cultures, and using digital channels professionally. Through hands-on, scenario-driven learning, you will strengthen coordination across departments while protecting the brand and keeping operations running smoothly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals in the hospitality sector who communicate daily with guests, teams, and partners. It provides tools and techniques for enhancing guest satisfaction and operational efficiency through effective communication.
audience: Restaurant and F&B supervisors and service staff
modules: Foundations of Effective Communication in Hospitality
Professional Language, Tone, and Service Etiquette
Digital and Written Communication in Hospitality
Communicating During Service Pressure and Crises
Leadership Communication for Supervisors and Managers
Designing Your Personal Communication Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of hospitality operations and previous experience in guest-facing roles. Proficiency in English is recommended for maximum engagement.
